name: Who Is Behind the Platform?
description:
Every CTF needs a platform.
But every platform has a story.
You have been given access to a CTF platform. Somewhere within its public traces is the identity of the person who started the project.
Your mission is to uncover the creator.
You are given only the following clues:
Clue 1
The platform is open source.
Clue 2
Its source code contains the history of its development.
Clue 3
The person you're looking for was not merely a contributor — they started the project.
Clue 4
Their name appears in the project's earliest history.

Submit the answer using:
pcgCTF{yourFLAGHEREE.......................}
